title: Thy Kingdom, Lord, Forever Stands
description: Thy Kingdom, Lord, Forever Stands in Tonic Solfa to YORK, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 132 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Providence Kind and Bountiful”, where the book credits them to the Eng. Bap. Collection.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to YORK; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Thy king-dom, Lord, for-ev-er stands, While earth-ly thrones de-cay; And time sub-mits to thy com-mands, While a-ges roll a-way.

lines: And time submits to thy commands,
Holy and just in all its ways
In all its works, immortal rays
The praise of God — delightful theme! —
Shall fill my heart and tongue;
Let all creation bless his name,

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to YORK by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
